summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase agreement dated August 27, 2026, to acquire all 3,800 shares of I-FLATZ Co., Ltd. from Toshihide Suzuki for JPY 612,692,000 (cash). I-FLATZ is the sole shareholder of LAND-I, forming the Target Company Group; post-closing, I-FLATZ becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. Closing is expected on or about September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions, including no material adverse effect and execution of management delegation agreements. Seller will be subject to non-compete and non-solicitation restrictions. Indemnification includes a JPY 5 million threshold, one-year survival for general reps, and liability caps of 50% (general) and 100% (fundamental) of the purchase price. The agreement is governed by Japanese law with Tokyo District Court jurisdiction. Watch for closing conditions and post-closing guarantee releases.
